prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences taught in the modules Machine Learning and either Foundations of Statistics or Elementary Stochastics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: explain the basics of generative models
demonstrate the application areas of generative models and assess their limitations
design and implement modern generative models
apply generative AI in practice and analyze the results reflectively and critically
take a stand on ethical and societal challenges of generative AI
apply scientific working methods in independently identifying, formulating, and solving problems

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments
Written exam or oral examination (individual examination)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercise assignments. Grading is from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Data Science degree program.
